 Cancer Shani Horoscope Today, 3 November 2026: Moon Squares Uranus Tonight, and Shani Warns Against a Sudden Job Move 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Nadi Horoscope Career Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Nadi Horoscope Career Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Nadi Horoscope Career Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Cancer Shani Horoscope Today, 3 November 2026: Moon Squares Uranus Tonight, and Shani Warns Against a Sudden Job Move 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 03, 2026, 02:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Restlessness about work may build steadily for Cancer this Tuesday and peak late at night. The Moon, your ruling planet, is moving through Magha in Leo, your second house of income and family savings. Close to midnight it forms a tense square with Uranus in Taurus, your eleventh house. That angle can spark a sudden urge to quit, change roles or grab an offer that seems to have dropped from nowhere. Shani, retrograde in Pisces in your ninth house, has one word for you. Wait. A career decision made on a single emotional evening can undo months of stability. An Offer That Arrives Out of the Blue 
 Uranus in your eleventh brings surprises through friends and professional contacts. Someone may mention an opening at their company, or a recruiter could call quoting a figure that sounds very attractive. With the Moon in your second house, you’ll instantly compare that number with your current salary. Watch Aries ,Taurus & Gemini : What This Phase May Be Trying to Warn You About | Ft. Shruti Kharbanda Comparing is reasonable. Doing it tonight is the problem. A square builds pressure, and pressure makes a poor guide for big career choices. Shani Wants Everything Checked 
 Shani’s third aspect from Pisces lands on Taurus, where Uranus sits. So any offer coming through your network needs a careful look before you take it seriously. Ask for a written letter with the exact role, the reporting line and the notice period. Shani’s tenth aspect also falls on Sagittarius, your sixth house of daily work and rivals. The present job may feel heavy right now. Even so, walking out without a backup plan carries real risk. A Short Fuse at the Office 
 Mars rules your tenth house of career and is debilitated in Cancer, your own sign. That makes career energy feel low and moody. And Tuesday is Mars’s own day, so small irritations at work can feel much bigger than they are. Take a breath before replying to a senior, especially in a meeting. Look at the Real Numbers 
 Jupiter and Ketu are in Leo with the Moon. Jupiter protects your money over the long run. Ketu, on the other hand, may leave you feeling underpaid for the effort you put in. Before deciding anything about your job, write down what you actually earn and save each month. The figure may be steadier than it feels tonight. Talk It Over at Home 
 Retrograde Venus sits in Libra, your fourth house, beside the Sun and a retrograde, combust Mercury. Share your work worries with family this evening. They may see it differently, and that outside view is useful right now. What to Do Today 
 Ask for any new offer in writing, and look at the full package, including leave, insurance and bonus, along with the salary. Talk it through with family before saying anything at work. Don’t resign tonight, avoid any argument with a senior, and keep offer details off social media. Shani Remedy for Today 
 Give a packed tiffin box to an office helper. In the evening, read once the Shani Stotra composed by King Dasharatha.
